title: RPG maker MV emotions faces set from Palxan and Verdibona

posts.author: Palxan
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
When released MV, I was quite saddened by the small amount of resources that he gave to the users.
First, emotions ... stone faces of characters is just awful!
I decided to remedy the situation by my own efforts.
The work was done a professional painter (
Verdibona
) in my request.
Don't I painted these works, but I made a order and paid the money, so I'm - the creator and have every right... to give them everything.
I hope that the results of the work will please you as well as pleasing to me.
TERMS of use:
Everything is made from RMMV stock media and is free for use with RPG Maker projects. Please credit Kadokawa/Enterbrain, Palxan and Verdibona if you use it.
Free for commercial and non-commercial use.

posts.author: Palxan
posts.body:
Credit Kadokawa/Enterbrain, Palxan and Verdibona if you use it.
This is not done for money, I just diversified my own game (remained unfinished).
Just mention us in the credits and I will be grateful.
If the Kadokawa against to the use of their materials, they would have closed this topic long ago.
And why should they be against it? We just added some elements to their pictures. We did not steal them.
But alas, it seems the Kadokawa is against using materials anywhere outside the Maker.

posts.author: Palxan
posts.body:
When you create a new game, a folder with its data appears on your computer. There is a path in this folder: img - faces.
Save new pictures on your computer and move them to the "faces" folder. Then they will appear when creating dialogs in your game.
